comments.body: No, not Alcantarea. There are actually two or three Alcantarea plants on picture 4 towards the back of the group (and to the right) - see the different leaves: more wide, a bit darker and with a different form - and some larger ones in the background (on the other side of the bare rock, also to the right of the picture), and also one plant visible in the background of pictures 2 and 3, hidden below the bush.
